page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highcpu-8 is an arm64-based virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration is tailored for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints.

This instance type does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU accelerators. Network configurations do not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Users requiring persistent storage must attach external block storage volumes, and those requiring public internet connectivity must provision external IP resources separately.

The arm64 architecture provides a cost-efficient alternative to traditional x86 architectures for workloads optimized for ARM instruction sets. With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is designed for compute-bound tasks such as web serving, containerized microservices, application servers, and distributed build systems where CPU execution speed is prioritized over memory capacity.
